name: Image to Video
intro: Image to Video in SmartVideo is an overview page where you can explore animation models and example motions before opening Video Studio.

features.highlight-cards: Four highlight cards summarize what animating an image can do, from motion effects to smooth animation. They are information only, not buttons.
features.available-models: The models grid shows featured animation model families, so you can see what is available before you start.
features.example-animations: Example cards pair a motion idea with a model. Click Try this to open Video Studio with ready made motion wording.
features.gtm-boost: The GTM Boost button opens a window where you describe your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and get a ready to use prompt.
features.animate-your-images: The Animate Your Images button opens Video Studio, which is the fastest way to start animating your own pictures.
features.get-started-free: Get Started Free also opens Video Studio, so you can move on once you have finished browsing.

outro: Look through the examples, pick a motion idea, and bring your first still image to life.
